extracted.name: Crock Pot Jambalaya
extracted.description: Great recipe for Crock Pot Jambalaya.
ingredient_lines: 1 Onion White or Yellow (doesn’t matter which)
1-2 Tablespoons Cajun seasoning (you can add more or less, depending on personal preference)
1/4 Teaspoon Cayenne Pepper (can completely omit if you want or add more for extra spice)
2-4 cups Raw Rice **** NOTE **** (Use ONLY 1 cup of raw rice if you plan on putting it into the crock pot to cook the last 40 mins of cooking time)
instruction_lines: Wash up your celery & bell peppers. Finely chop up the celery, bell peppers & onion. Place into the crock pot.
Chop your sausage into bite size pieces. Rinse & cube your chicken into small pieces. Place both sausage & chicken into the crock pot.
Add your seasonings, diced tomatoes, tomato paste & chicken broth to the crock. Stir all ingredients well.
Cook on Low 8 Hours or 6 Hours on High. Ensure your chicken is cooked all the way through before serving.

The last Hour of cooking tome, add your Shrimp. If you decide to add 1 cup of raw rice to the crock pot to cook, add it the last 40 minutes. If not, cook your desired amount of rice; separately as you normally would.
